description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Tenet3 is a digital knowledge management company focused on cybersecurity, system trustworthiness, software and hardware assurance, machine learning, and knowledge graphs. The Junior Frontend Software Engineer will build reliable, accessible, and performant user-facing components with React, HTML, and CSS while contributing to scoped features, code reviews, debugging, documentation, and Agile team processes.
Frontend engineer building accessible React user interfaces and refining reusable components

Responsibilities:
• Build user-facing features using React, HTML, and CSS, following established design systems and accessibility standards
• Contribute to the implementation and refinement of scoped tickets and user stories
• Participate in code reviews by incorporating feedback and applying best practices
• Debug common issues, identify performance or accessibility concerns, and raise blockers with clarity
• Attend team standups, demos, and retrospectives; provide clear updates and seek feedback proactively
• Maintain component documentation and ensure changes are communicated clearly to teammates
• Implement responsive, accessible UI components using React and semantic HTML/CSS
• Follow established workflows, checklists, and coding standards in an Agile environment
• Enhance overall application performance, accessibility, and UI consistency

Requirements:
• Proficiency in modern JavaScript, HTML, and CSS (including layout techniques), with direct experience building web interfaces using React and component libraries
• Knowledge of semantic HTML, responsive design techniques, version control systems (e.g., Git/GitHub), and Agile tools (e.g., Jira, GitHub Issues)
• 1–3 years of experience (including college internships) in frontend development, with an understanding of reusable design patterns and component architecture
• Clear written and verbal communication in technical discussions, with the ability to maintain component documentation and convey technical issues clearly
• Willingness to receive and act on feedback during code reviews, a strong desire for continuous learning, and comfort contributing in daily standups and async platforms
• Demonstrated ability to debug UI issues, propose targeted solutions when blocked, and begin connecting front-end implementation choices with user needs and business goals
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, civil engineering, mathematics, physics, or a related technical field
